Remark
[low-dimensional Hausdorff approximations of a cube]

Source: petersen:page-0453 ↗ def:pet-ch11-hausdorff-distance 1. ch11:11.6.1Construct a sequence of $1$-dimensional metric spaces converging in Hausdorff distance to the unit cube $[0,1]^3$ with the metric from the maximum norm on $\mathbb {R}^3$. Then find surfaces (jungle gyms) converging to the same space.
